risk_summary: The excerpt is substantially quantified and transparent about major exposures, particularly opioid litigation, COVID-19 impacts, inventory reserves, and tax benefits. Risk tone is materially negative because litigation charges drove a sharp swing from prior-year GAAP operating loss, although operating performance, liquidity, and mitigation actions are presented constructively. Dense accounting reconciliations and repeated cross-references make the disclosure harder to interpret but do not appear deliberately evasive.
